name: AEFP 2027 Annual Conference
organizer: Association for Education Finance and Policy (AEFP)
call_type: Papers, posters, Spotlight Policy Dialogues and Conversation Groups
deadline_note: Extended from 2 October 2026. Call opened 14 August 2026.
submission_requirements: Proposal via Oxford Abstracts (free account, not tied to AEFP membership). Papers, posters and Policy Dialogues max 1,000 words; Conversation Groups max 300 words. Full-paper panel submissions not considered. Presenter on only one paper/poster submission, plus at most one Spotlight Policy Dialogue and/or one Conversation Group. If findings are preliminary, more complete findings expected two weeks before the conference.
registration_fee: Not yet posted (registration opens 11 Dec 2026; early-bird rate until 31 Jan 2027, regular until 28 Feb 2027, late until 17 Mar 2027)
membership_required: No (AEFP membership not required to submit)
